title: Reading card and dictation sheet
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y8 lesson 13 (Reading card and dictation sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 13: Bridge: reading fluency and dictation. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Then smooth reading
points: Read the word, not the letters
Look ahead to the next word
Join الـ to the word before: فِي البَيْتِ (fi l-bayt)

parts.text: Join smoothly: dhahaba t-talibu ila l-madrasah

box.title: Write the sentences your teacher says, with all the harakat

questions.q: Read aloud: جَلَسَ الوَلَدُ عَلَى الكُرْسِيِّ.
questions.a: jalasa l-waladu 'ala l-kursiyyi: The boy sat on the chair.

questions.q: Which word has a shaddah: مُعَلِّمٌ or مَدْرَسَةٌ?
Core: Dictation: write the five words and two sentences the teacher reads, with all vowels.
questions.a: Words: قَلَمٌ، بَيْتٌ، مَدْرَسَةٌ، مُعَلِّمٌ، سَيَّارَةٌ. Sentences: ذَهَبَ الطَّالِبُ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ. البَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ.

questions.q: Extend: Read the two dictation sentences to a partner in a breakout room and time each other.
questions.a: Fluent reading in under 10 seconds each

questions.q: Stretch: Write one new sentence of your own with al- after a word, and mark which letter is not said.
questions.a: For example: جَلَسْتُ فِي الغُرْفَةِ (the alif of al- is not said).

questions.q: How is فِي البَيْتِ read in joined speech?
questions.a: B) fi l-bayt. The alif of al- is not pronounced after a word: fi l-bayt.

questions.q: What does إِمْلَاء mean? A) dictation B) reading C) sentence
Big question: what makes an Arabic reader fluent?
questions.a: Accurate vowels and long vowels, reading whole words and joining words smoothly.
